message.content: {"objective": "Resolve the check by recapturing bxc3, restoring material (two bishops for rook) and keeping the c6-knight.", "rationale": "b2c3 is the only commit_ready move: verified single-candidate at depth 4, exact score -39, safety.complete with no mating reply and no tactical/checking-chain refutation.
